scientific_integrity: The displayed cycles are checked directly from ternary expansions. Minimality is a finite exhaustive statement: the packaged verifier evaluates every positive start below \(4096\) using exact integer arithmetic and follows each orbit to repetition.
scientific_limitations: The claim classifies periodic points only below \(4096\) and identifies the first point of period at least \(3\). It does not classify all cycles or establish unconditional stabilization for every orbit.
title: First nontrivial periods of the ternary 2-shifted Sloane map
